title: Lesson 48 place-name and gentilic NNC technical proof

groups.title: Place-name NNC domain and finite agreement
groups.proposal: Build place names as typed adverbial NNCs whose formation, boundary, agreement, and finite Result come from the canonical owner.
groups.readingJob: Show Source kind, place formation, adverbial use, unique-reference facts, agreement, and finite projection.
groups.decisionSplit: Only Source and licensed formation are choices; noun class and finite agreement are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize a place name from translation, stored answers, or caller target segments.

groups.title: n place-name formation group
groups.proposal: Compose n place names from exact imperfect, nonactive, yan, man, tlan-vicinity, can, preterit-agentive, and action-noun Sources.
groups.readingJob: Show upstream Source formation, voice, participant mapping, matrix variant, and resulting place stem.
groups.decisionSplit: The upstream formation is the genuine choice; place boundary and class follow canonically.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct upstream VNC or Deverbal Results from their written surfaces.

groups.title: pan place-name formation group
groups.proposal: Compose integrated and connective-t pan place names from exact typed nounstem Sources.
groups.readingJob: Show integrated or linked Source mode, connective boundary, pan matrix, and finite place Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Formation is selectable only where the exact Source licenses it.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not select the boundary from the final spelling.

groups.title: co or c place-name group
groups.proposal: Derive co or c from the typed Source boundary while preserving affective embeds, relational compounds, and ambiguity evidence.
groups.readingJob: Show Source edge, co/c realization, affective or compound Source history, and any unresolved analysis.
groups.decisionSplit: Only genuine lexical analysis is selectable; ordinary co/c realization is automatic.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not derive the matrix variant by editing a displayed word.

groups.title: tlah, tzalan, ti-tlan, and chan place groups
groups.proposal: Compose the remaining place-name families through their exact abundance, relational, connective, topographical, and supplementation boundaries.
groups.readingJob: Show family, embedded Source, matrix, topographical boundary, supplementation, and translation uncertainty separately.
groups.decisionSplit: Family and typed Source are choices; supplementation and boundary realization are owner-derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not turn uncertain translation into grammar authority.

groups.title: Gentilic ca routes from place names
groups.proposal: Build gentilic NNCs from exact place-name Sources through full-place, pan-eca, can-meca, co/c-silent, ownerhood-n-silent, and man/tlan-teca routes.
groups.readingJob: Show upstream place identity, selected gentilic route, silent boundary replacement, derived noun class, and agreement.
groups.decisionSplit: Gentilic route follows the exact place formation; hidden noun class is never a user authority.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct a place Source or override derived class from hidden state.

groups.title: Nonlocative, agentive, and alternative gentilic routes
groups.proposal: Preserve nonlocative absolutive, preterit-agentive owner and other, alternative, concatenated-clause, and defective-spelling gentilic distinctions.
groups.readingJob: Show Source family, agentive provenance, alternative route, clause structure, spelling ambiguity, and exact agreement.
groups.decisionSplit: Only route distinctions licensed by the typed Source are selectable.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not resolve defective spelling or ambiguity by inventing a formula.

groups.title: Gentilic extension architecture
groups.proposal: Reuse exact gentilic Results for incorporation, collectivity, possessive collectivity, adjectival use, profession, title, and extension continuations.
groups.readingJob: Show upstream gentilic identity, extension kind, collectivity state, possessor variant, incorporation matrix, and lexical closure.
groups.decisionSplit: Only extension values licensed for the exact Result are available.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer extensions from a matching surface or lesson label.

groups.title: Gentilic incorporation, adjectival use, and collectivity
groups.proposal: Carry exact gentilic nounstems into licensed compounds, adjectival NNC use, and yō collectivity while preserving state and scalar-paradigm identity.
groups.readingJob: Show Source Result, target operation, matrix or modifier role, yō collectivity, possessive num1 variant, and output identity.
groups.decisionSplit: Matrix, use, or possessive variant is selectable only where licensed.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not accept arbitrary caller matrices or copied gentilic Results.

groups.title: Closed professions and titles
groups.proposal: Realize only Canvas-licensed profession and title records, keeping evidence-only Tlīllān-calqui visible but non-generative because no typed formula is supplied.
groups.readingJob: Show lexical record, profession or title kind, typed formula availability, pertinency continuation, and evidence-only status.
groups.decisionSplit: Only a listed productive record is selectable for generation.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize the closed lexicon or invent a formula for evidence-only records.
